<subject>Catherine Storey for Corporate Litigation Transaction Deadlines</subject>
<body>
I spoke with each of you a couple of weeks ago, and this matter was deferred due to other urgent priorities. However, all agreed that setting a uniform transaction deadline was reasonable for US and Canadian litigation and advisory cases.

The best approach would be to set a final submission deadline at 4pm daily (to give a sense of volume, I reviewed yesterday’s activity to see how many matters were recorded after 4pm London time. There were three US litigation cases and two Canadian corporate advisories). After 4pm, any new cases would automatically be deferred to the following business day. That said, for cases not deferred after 4pm, the respective risk teams must be aware these will count towards the next day’s workload. 

I am unsure how compliance procedures at Meridian would need adjusting for the daily case status reports, since the official records would exclude these late filings. Can Compliance generate supplementary reports to ensure each team has accurate case data each morning?

I welcome any feedback you may have, and in any event, please confirm that a 4pm deadline suits your respective teams.

Danielle  
x36557

Eric – do you foresee any issues with the docket processing system?  
Mary – we touched on this briefly a few weeks ago… any additional thoughts?  
</body>
